turns.content: Bicyclo[2.2.2]octan-2-one is irradiated with ultraviolet light, giving product 1 with the same molecular mass. Infer the likely photochemical product structure.
Product 1 is hydrogenated over palladium on carbon under H2. Determine product 2 from the structure proposed above.
Identify the most deshielded proton in the 1H NMR spectrum of product 2.
Identify the structural and experimental features that control how this observation should appear.
Apply the analysis rule appropriate to the selected method and feature, and explain the predicted response.
Determine the resulting response for that feature.
Check whether the reaction sequence and available evidence are internally consistent with the assignment.
Report the assignment and justify it from the evidence used.
